parsed.why: No trans-specific criminal or border rule, courts partly protective (anti-LGBT minors law struck down, partnership ruling), but documented societal hostility, police assembly-protection failure, unimplemented recognition; worst feature is tier-3 hostility with thin recourse.

Cross-dressing legal, recognition since 1982 without surgery, NHS-covered hormones, courts convicting attackers of trans tourists and a baton-wielding officer; offset by diffuse transphobia, no nationwide GI anti-discrimination, prison gaps.

Same-sex decriminalised 2023 and Pride policed/protected with PM backing, but no recognition or GI discrimination cover, 2018 Pride annulled after death threats, 2024 election hate speech, hospital discrimination. No criminalisation of trans identity.

Criminal law silent on trans identity, no prisons, but institutional doctrine frames gender theory/sex-change as threatening, no protections or recognition, and visitor-facing entry/facility practice undocumented — thin-data extrapolation to conservative institutional hostility.

De-facto criminalisation of gender nonconformity through indecent-acts provisions (up to 5 years), unchangeable documents, no protections, plus documented militia killings of effeminate men in armed-group-held territory: state-tolerated organised targeting.
